data.name: Kaylyn
data.gender_notes: Kaylyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kalliope' meaning 'beautiful voice' and the Hebrew name 'Kelilah' meaning 'slender or little one'. In Christian tradition, Kaylyn is believed to represent the pure and cleansing qualities of the Virgin Mary. The name Kaylyn carries the meaning “Pure, Slender, Cleansing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kaylyn usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, slender, cleansing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaylyn total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
